entities.summary: Mehdi Ali oglu Huseynov, better known by the pseudonym Mehdi Huseyn, was an Azerbaijani and Soviet writer and critic, laureate of the State Stalin Prize of the third degree (1950) and member of the All-Union Communist Party since 1941.
